title: The radial lift x ↦ φ(‖x − ξ‖/ρ) of a C^∞ profile with φ = 1 on (−∞, 1/2] is C^∞
statement: Let m ∈ N, ξ ∈ R^m (Euclidean space EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), ρ > 0, and let φ : R → R be C^infinity with φ(t) = 1 for every t <= 1/2. Then the function ζ : R^m → R, ζ(x) := φ(‖x − ξ‖/ρ), is C^infinity.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : Rn m) (ρ : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ρ → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → (∀ t, t ≤ 1 / 2 → φ t = 1) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Rn m => φ (‖x - ξ‖ / ρ))
